pavers:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production seamless square top-down floor texture for a premium toy miniature city construction game.
Primary request: a perfectly flat orthographic overhead view of a quiet, elegant paved city plaza. A 4 by 4 regular grid of broad square pale warm gray limestone pavers. Uniform paver color warm ivory-gray #DAD9CF with very subtle cool gray edge occlusion #BEC3BD, a few extremely faint soft mineral flecks. Smooth matte architectural model / toy city material, clean beveled slab edges with thin 1% wide tidy grout joints. Lighting completely diffuse and flat, no directional cast shadows, no perspective. Tile-to-tile color variation less than 4 percent. Avoid cream-yellow or brown dirt. This is a texture for actual 3D ground geometry, not an image of a platform. No plants, buildings, objects, roads, letters, symbols, borders, visible outer edges or vignettes. Exactly four rows and four columns of large broad tiles; pattern tiles seamlessly in both axes. High quality clean hand painted toy game material, no photoreal grain. Full bleed square opaque image.
fence:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single transparent panoramic foreground boundary sprite for a premium miniature city building game. Landscape 2048 by 1024 canvas. Object is a very WIDE and LOW horizontal strip, about 7 times wider than its actual visible height, centered with abundant transparent space above and below. Slightly elevated frontal orthographic view, clean toy architectural model style. One continuous low construction-site boundary along a horizontal sidewalk: short matte slate blue #6F8E9A panels with cream stone posts and flat cream coping, subtle pale cyan highlights on panels. At the far left and right only, small neat built-in sage green planter beds and two tiny construction yellow and dark navy striped bollards. Central third is visually QUIET: low plain blue panels, no sign, no signboard, no gate arch, no objects, no text. Feet sit on one straight thin ivory curb baseline. Posts chunky simple and few, no ornate gold, no chain link mesh, no shed, no metal wire, no bright orange plastic wall, no traffic cones, no tall hedge. Soft matte plaster material, restrained ambient occlusion, calm coherent shapes that read at 750px screen width. Cream #FFF7E6, slate blue #6F8E9A, sage #9AB8A3, construction gold #F5BC51. This is scenery, not UI: no panel border around the image. True alpha transparency everywhere outside the single low boundary object. No background, sky, ground plane, shadows floating outside its feet, watermark or typography.
city:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production panoramic transparent city background for a premium miniature tower stacking game. A single wide frontal city skyline, about 2.7 times wider than tall. Entire city stands on one uniform narrow horizontal sidewalk base, with transparent surroundings. Soft 3D miniature architectural model style, clean broad plaster shapes, crisp simple silhouettes, restrained ambient occlusion, warm daylight from upper left.
A coherent MODERN URBAN neighborhood of cream rectangular mid-rise apartment and office buildings, blue gray glass windows, pale peach accents, occasional warm terracotta roof details. Several cozy low buildings along the front, slightly taller blue glass buildings behind, a few carefully composed rounded sage green trees and small shrubs at street level. Buildings mainly straight rectangular forms, two or three broad windows across per facade, simple flat roofs with restrained cornices, small roofs or terraces; NO domes, turrets, minarets, palaces, castles or fantasy spires. Quiet architectural details that read at mobile scale. Left and right sides may be a little taller, middle is lower and airier for the player's tower silhouette. Color palette cream #FFF7E6, desaturated blue #7BABBF, muted peach #DB9983, sage #9AB8A3, tiny restrained gold details. No giant central player tower, crane, characters, roads in perspective, construction barriers, sky, clouds, text, UI or real brand logos. Genuine alpha transparent background, no dark backdrop, no floor plane; all shapes separated cleanly from transparency with no outer glow. Wide landscape composition, production game art.
highrise-city:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent panoramic DISTANT CITY BACKDROP for a vertical tower-stacking game. This city must be clearly a DIFFERENT VISUAL DEPTH from a sharp cream-and-terracotta foreground toy building. Build one dense modern high-rise metropolis skyline, with many closely spaced tall glass office towers and apartment skyscrapers, NOT a low-rise neighborhood. Wide composition approximately 2.1:1, straight level horizontal ground baseline. Tower heights vary naturally; tall towers at the sides, several medium towers through the center, leaving the very center's roofline somewhat lower so the falling gameplay block stays readable. Twenty to thirty slender buildings across, plus an additional distant row of smaller towers. Recognizable tall modern skyscrapers, flat and chamfered rooftops, occasional simple antenna, no historical domes or palace spires.
CRITICAL STYLE AND COLOR: this is a softly painted atmospheric background, NOT foreground toy architecture. Entire palette is restrained, LOW SATURATION cool blue-gray. Nearest skyline row #8BADC2, rear row #AEC5D3, farthest row #CDDAE3. Quiet tiny vertical window grids rendered in slightly darker blue-gray, with very low contrast, no crisp black lines. The farthest buildings are softened and lighter by atmospheric haze. No warm cream facades, no beige or terracotta building walls, no saturated cyan glass, no bright gold roofs, no greenery foreground trees, no street furniture. Keep building surfaces simpler and less contrasty than the sharp foreground game tower, yet make the high-rise density and vertical height unmistakable. Matte 2D environmental illustration, gentle atmospheric perspective, no photoreal noise, no shiny 3D toy render.
Every building stands on one consistent baseline. Transparent background everywhere outside the skyline shape. No sky rectangle, gradient backdrop, clouds, sun, ground plane or street in perspective, no crane or falling block, no people, no text, no logos, no UI. No white glow outline. Clean alpha edges with subtle soft internal shading. One finished skyline asset, not a contact sheet.
